markImageDescriptions.markImageDescription: The mark consists of the word "qori" represented in a stylized font and a design consisting of the graphic representation of a 3D geometrical shape before the name. The geometrical shape is a rhombus which is slightly overlapped with a triangle in the lower right corner. Therefore the shape resembles the letter "q".
